findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now an abstract class that cannot be instantiated
findings.body: The handler changed from a concrete DetectorHandler to a StatefulDetectorHandler with an empty body. StatefulDetectorHandler has abstract members (counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and the new build_occurrence_and_event_data). Any Detector of type metric_alert_fire will raise TypeError when `detector_handler` instantiates it, which breaks process_detectors for these detectors. Previously the handler was instantiable and returned an empty result.

findings.title: New abstract method lacks docstring and no test covers resolve vs occurrence contract
findings.body: build_occurrence_and_event_data is a new abstract hook on StatefulDetectorHandler, but it has no docstring describing its contract (for example, what event_data must contain, or that it is only called for non-OK statuses). Implementers have to read evaluate_group_key_value to find out. Adding an abstract method also breaks every existing subclass at instantiation time.
